blocks.x: Advanced Risk & Predictive Analytics, shipped on a signed baseline: the scope we take, the weekly delivery rhythm, the platform rails underneath, and the delta we commit to at every gate.

Risk analytics earns its keep when it changes decisions: limits adjusted, reserves calibrated, interventions targeted. We build predictive models across credit risk, insurance pricing and reserving, operational risk sensing, churn and default early warning — always with explainability (SHAP-class attribution), stability monitoring and documented validation aligned to SR 11-7 / TRIM expectations. Champion-challenger discipline keeps the model room honest.

The differentiator is integration: scores flow into decision hubs with policy layers, into risk dashboards with the operating cadence, and into stress scenarios that finance and risk run jointly. Model risk documentation — development evidence, validation findings, limitations — is produced as part of delivery, not reconstructed for audit a year later.

This capability runs on the cadence set out below; the rhythm is fixed, the scope is signed. Weeks 1–2 measure and sign the baseline with your team; nothing builds against an unsigned number. Weeks 3–8 prove the pattern on deliberately bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — under a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked into runbooks, monitoring and enablement, closing with a measured delta against the baseline. Every gate is pass, stop or redirect, in writing.
